source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
3. Find out what specific electrical safety checks
    ರಲ್ಲಿfailed.
4. Describe the failure:
     a. Use diagrams or photos.
     b. Include the following details:
     a. Specific instrument used
     b. Instrument condition at time of use
     c. Electrical test results before and after test.
     d. Detailed comment about the appliance, covering the following areas:
          i.  Any unusual test conditions that might lead to an anomaly.
          ii. Where test values are not as expected.
          iii. Where any tests appear to show inconsistent results.
          iv. Any further test requirements, including any additional tests.
          v.  Use of special test methods (e.g. High Voltage Test).
ويړ
4. Sign and date the report

To sign in the test record, you must use the same name and email used on the test certificate and report.
